name: Mint Master
summary:
Mint Master is an idle tycoon game about running a coin mint, built on real coin history. The player starts by pressing Wheat Pennies, hires workers to automate the presses and grows the mint's fortune from dollars into the trillions. Presses can strike error coins such as a Doubled Die, an Off-Center Strike, a Clipped Planchet or a Double Strike, and each new error adds income to that coin.

There are five mint worlds and 50 coins, from the American Mint to the Legendary Mint with Atlantis and El Dorado. The game also has an arcade coin pusher, a coin designer, a three-day Mint Rally against rival mints and a weekly leaderboard.
